top_findings: 13 pages under 500 words — thin content risk
All detail pages share same OG image
quick_wins: Add width/height attributes to content images
Create page-specific OG images for top pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt open to all crawlers with sitemap directive
Proper canonical URLs on all pages
hreflang tags (en + x-default) on every page
Clean semantic URL structure

findings.title: 5 pages missing from sitemap.xml
findings.description: china-packing-list, china-prep-checklist, china-trip-builder, guilin-trip-cost-calculator, and yangshuo-cycling-routes exist in dist/ but are not listed in sitemap.xml
findings.recommendation: Update sitemap generation to include all built pages

findings.title: No trailing-slash redirect
findings.description: Both /page and /page/ resolve without redirect, risking duplicate indexing
findings.recommendation: Add 301 redirect from non-slash to slash version

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Unique meta descriptions on every page
Practical, authoritative writing style
Clear topical structure from destination guides to logistics

findings.title: 13 pages under 500 words
findings.description: Nine informational pages need expansion: li-river-cruise (334), best-time-to-visit-guilin (366), about (260), and more
findings.recommendation: Expand priority pages to 800+ words with practical details

findings.title: No author bylines or author pages
findings.description: Missing author credentials and editorial standards hurts E-E-A-T signals
findings.recommendation: Add author pages and bylines with travel credentials

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Well-optimized title tags (50-70 characters)
Exactly one H1 per page
Strong internal linking via footer navigation

findings.title: Flat heading hierarchy on 16 pages
findings.description: 16 pages have h2s with no h3s, missing deeper content structure signals
findings.recommendation: Add h3 subheadings under major sections

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: WebSite schema on all pages
FAQPage schema on homepage with 8 questions
Article + BreadcrumbList on all detail pages

findings.title: No ImageObject schema on detail pages
findings.description: Pages with hero images lack structured image data for rich results

categories.name: Performance
what_works: All WebP images with lazy loading
Font preloading with CDN preconnect
Minimal CSS (28KB)

findings.title: Main JS bundle is 182KB
findings.description: Heavy for a content site, loads site-wide even when no interactive tools are used
findings.recommendation: Code-split tool components to load only on their pages

findings.title: No critical CSS inlining
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS for above-fold content

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: FAQPage schema helps AI overviews
BreadcrumbList schema for site structure
Clean semantic HTML for LLM scraping

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Missing standardized AI crawler discovery file

categories.name: Images
what_works: All WebP format
Alt text on every image
Eager on hero, lazy on content images

findings.title: Card images lack width/height dimensions
findings.description: Missing dimensions cause Cumulative Layout Shift as images load
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all image tags

findings.title: No responsive image strategy
findings.description: No srcset/sizes attributes — all devices download 150-231KB images
findings.recommendation: Generate multiple sizes and use srcset for responsive delivery

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Consider reader reviews and Review schema
